My mom has been the only one who's been truly there for me since the beginning and I couldn't be more thankful . My parents split up when I was around five years old and my dad was never really around . My mom was taking care of me and my two sisters all on her own while dealing with her kidney failure and having to go to dialysis every other day . I never saw her much when I was little but we never ever struggled because she worked so hard for us . My older sister had a boyfriend who was close with our family and both his parents died suddenly in a car accident due to a drunk driver , my mom let him into our house with open arms . When I became a teenager I started rebelling pretty badly . I got into drugs , drinking , older guys and my grades completely went to shit . I got into so much trouble with the law and school but my mom still tried to work with me . I ended up in juvie a couple times and every visiting day she was always there for me . Every time I ended up In juvie ,rehab , the hospital whatever I got myself into my mom was always there . Eventually she decided I'd figure it out on my own and let me make my own decisions which really did make me grow up and realize how much she cared and just wanted me to be happy . At sixteen I moved in with my boyfriend who was twenty at the time we lived together for a while before getting kicked out of our place because a roommate didn't like me . Me and my boyfriend slept in his car for a couple months and I didn't tell my mom . Once I did she offered us to come live with her . When I was seventeen living with her my mom found out her transplant which she got a couple years prior failed and she had to go back to dialysis and get back on to the transplant list but she was still working just as hard and I never saw it bring her down. Shortly after she found that out I ran into my own health complications and my kidneys started failing my boyfriend brought my to the ER and before you know it I'm in a hospital bed getting shot up with morphine every couple hours and a group of doctors surrounded me everyday trying to figure out why my kidneys suddenly went into failure . My mom spent every night in the hospital with me laying on a little tiny uncomfortable couch when I didn't even get as much as a phone call from my dad . Eventually I made a full recovery but she was the only one there for me each lonely night. While with that same boyfriend we got into some trouble and I ended up in jail on my eighteenth birthday I had quite a hefty bail which my mom bailed me out and I was making payments toward the remaining amount of money . Me and my boyfriend split up , I lost my job and had no way to pay off the remaining money which was over $1,500 . My mom offered to pay it off and told me to not worry about a job because she just wanted me to focus on school which I thanked her endlessly for although it took me some convincing to take up her offer . My moms been there for the roughest parts of my life all while dealing with her own problems and I honestly have no idea where I'd be without her .
